scripts.start: node scripts/verificar-entorno.mjs development && ng serve -c development
scripts.start:staging: node scripts/verificar-entorno.mjs staging && ng serve -c staging
scripts.build: node scripts/verificar-entorno.mjs production && ng build -c production
scripts.build:development: node scripts/verificar-entorno.mjs development && ng build -c development
scripts.build:staging: node scripts/verificar-entorno.mjs staging && ng build -c staging
scripts.watch: node scripts/verificar-entorno.mjs development && ng build --watch --configuration development
